final_elements.name: watch case
final_elements.description: One round metal watch case centered slightly right, with a small left hinge tab.

final_elements.name: open lid
final_elements.description: One tilted oval lid attached at the case left hinge, without crossing the case outline.

final_elements.name: dial ring
final_elements.description: One smaller concentric dial ring inside the case.

final_elements.name: watch hands
final_elements.description: Two different-length hands meeting at the dial center.

final_elements.name: top winding knob
final_elements.description: One small ridged winding knob attached at twelve o’clock.

final_elements.name: dial ticks and shadow
final_elements.description: Sparse hour ticks within the ring and a short broken shadow beneath case and lid.

frames.visible_job: Draw the round case and small left hinge tab.
frames.instruction: Draw one broad round case slightly right of page center and a small hinge tab on its left edge. Leave blank paper to the left for the lid.

frames.visible_job: From the left hinge gap, draw one tilted oval lid to the left and a narrow inner rim; keep the original watch case in place.
frames.instruction: From the left hinge gap, draw one tilted oval lid to the left and a narrow inner rim; keep the original watch case in place.

frames.visible_job: Inside the case, add a smaller round dial ring. From its center, draw one short hand toward two o’clock and one longer hand toward ten o’clock.
frames.instruction: Inside the case, add a smaller round dial ring. From its center, draw one short hand toward two o’clock and one longer hand toward ten o’clock.

frames.visible_job: At the case top, attach a short ridged winding knob. Mark a few short hour ticks inside the dial and put broken shadow strokes below case and lid.
frames.instruction: At the case top, attach a short ridged winding knob. Mark a few short hour ticks inside the dial and put broken shadow strokes below case and lid.

final_step.visible_job: Shade the existing case, open lid, dial, knob and ground with warm graphite; add no new structure.
final_step.instruction: Darken the established case and lid rims with 2B pencil, shade one side of the existing dial and knob, and soften the broken ground shadow. Leave a small paper highlight on the metal.

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved crop contains a round case and small left hinge tab, with blank paper for the lid; a beginner can set scale from this one form.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: All five saved crops show one case at the same scale. The left lid remains hinged, dial ring and both hands stay centered, the knob and ticks appear before finish, and shading adds no contour. No temporary guides appear.
